selection.reason: Retain the combined arithmetic and bounded witness fusion candidate for final qualification. Arithmetic won all three initial pairs (2.93% median paired reduction). Fusion won four of five direct pairs with a small 0.80% median paired reduction and a -0.99% to +1.58% range; the unpaired medians are effectively neutral. The fusion result is treated as modest and variable, with a clear reduction in launch and instrumentation overhead. All 26 targeted checks passed and managed allocation peaks were unchanged. Final performance claims use the separate five-pair baseline/combined series across four workloads.

plan.reason: Initial five native-wallet pairs had three wins but a slower candidate median; assess repeatability with a fixed larger sample.
plan.dependency: cold-cache-results.json must exist before any GPU work

component_screen.scope: GPU event timings only; builds may run concurrently on CPU. Full-prover qualification is separate.

timer_boundaries.four: Aggregation timer includes fresh program setup, proving, in-process native verification and serialization; excludes GPU initialization, original wallet proof creation, fixture registration, builds, and independent CPU root audit.
timer_boundaries.single: Controller launch-to-exit worker window includes GPU initialization, barrier, proving, in-process verification, serialization and shutdown; excludes builds and independent CPU root audit.
timer_boundaries.concurrent: Controller launch-to-last-exit cohort window, two independent eight-input roots; same inclusions as single.
timer_boundaries.wallet: Native JoinSplit proving call plus GPU drain, including ABI proof serialization; excludes GPU initialization, buffer setup, artifact file writes and independent CPU proof/public-statement audit.

interpretation: Final medians use five alternating pairs per workload. Screening, warmups, profile captures and cache experiments are excluded.
Profile event duration sums and nested host spans are nonadditive. Uncovered device intervals are not measured GPU idle time.
Host spans are elapsed times; inclusive process CPU counters include all process threads and driver activity.
Concurrent device clock domains were not merged or treated as synchronized.
Kernel resource queries do not measure hardware occupancy or bandwidth saturation.
NVML energy is whole-board energy over the monitored window, not whole-system energy or per-worker attribution.
Current baseline already contains the earlier RNG batching optimization; no multiplicative combination with older percentages is claimed.
Aggregation begins with existing wallet proofs; two eight-input jobs do not qualify one sixteen-input aggregation tree.

Native-wallet follow-up contains twenty additional alternating pairs prompted by the variable original five-pair result; original, follow-up and pooled summaries remain separate, with no excluded samples.

retained_unsuccessful_attempts.reason: Initial component helper import overwrote ROOT, producing a FileNotFoundError before the screen; corrected helper and successful run retained separately.
New test used ORDER instead of ORDER_U64; corrected before successful test build.
Source-hash guard detected a concurrent test-only edit; both release binaries were rebuilt and pinned against final source.
Initial test controller lacked a parent output directory; no tests ran before correction.

Broad substring filter also selected native lifecycle and hybrid quotient tests. Intended six DFT/commitment tests and lifecycle test passed; two hybrid tests were rejected by the strict GPU-required policy. Corrected filter reran the six intended tests successfully.

final_assessment: All fifteen aggregation qualification pairs improved. The twenty-pair native-wallet follow-up was effectively unchanged (11 wins, -0.020 percent reduction in median time); the selected changes are retained for consistent aggregation gains. The single cold-cache comparison had longer compilation for the selected build; warmed throughput and startup latency are reported separately.
